about: Three-way merge of one ink group's strokes: gamma/ink.py merge_ink and frontend/src/ink/ink.js mergeInk read these cases (docs/dev/handwriting.md 'Two writers, one group'). A stroke is [id, v] or [id, v, look]: v names a version of the stroke's GEOMETRY (the loaders build a stroke whose first sample is x = 100 + 100 v, so two versions of one id lie at different places), and the optional `look` object spreads its keys over the loaders' default stroke (tool pen, color #1f1f1f, size 1.6, opacity 1, pen true, ch xy): color, opacity, brush, dash, nib, band, fill restyle it, size changes its geometry, and `from` makes it a piece cut from the stroke of that id. A result stroke is written the same way: [id, v] plus, when any of those keys differs from the default (or `from` is present), an object of the differing keys. `base` null means the base file is unknown; `base_ids` (optional) are then the ids the writer saw in it. `lost_ours` and `returned` (optional) are the ids the answer reports — ours' changes the result dropped, and strokes theirs had erased that ours' change brings back; a case without them checks only `result` and `clean`.
